# EL LEARNERS APP - Full System Documentation & Technical Reference

## Executive Summary
EL LEARNERS APP is a modern, enterprise-grade Next.js multi-tenant school management system and Computer-Based Testing (CBT) portal. Designed specifically for primary and secondary educational institutions, it streamlines administration, examination, grading, communication, and fee processing into a single real-time ecosystem.

---

## Key Modules & Functional Architecture

### 1. Multi-Tenant Institution Management
- Unique School Registration Codes for each institutional tenant.
- School Admin dashboard for managing academic sessions, terms, classes, arms, and staff accounts.
- Document verification, proof of address verification, and Korapay automated payment onboarding.

### 2. Computer-Based Testing (CBT) & Assessment Engine
- Live timed examinations with web proctoring (camera snapshots, tab switch detection, cheating telemetry).
- Support for multiple-choice questions, short answers, essay questions, and file uploads.
- Instant server-side grading and automatic percentage score calculation.
- Post-exam detailed review and strength/weakness diagnostics.

### 3. Automated Academic Report Cards
- Subject score aggregation across Continuous Assessment (CA1, CA2, CA3) and End-of-Term Examinations.
- Automated grade letter assignment (A, B, C, D, F) and position ranking within class/arm.
- Role-based workflow: Teachers draft and enter scores; School Admins / Principals review, endorse, or reject report cards.
- PDF generation and instant parent portal delivery.

### 4. Multi-Role Portals & Dashboards
- **Super Admin**: Platform-wide control, tenant activation, subscription management, global logs, support tickets.
- **School Admin**: School staff management, fee tracking, timetable scheduling, class assignment, report card approval.
- **Teacher**: Lesson planning, grade entry, attendance taking, CBT test creation, student proctoring.
- **Student**: CBT exam launcher, live grade tracking, timetable viewer, digital library access, homework submission.
- **Parent**: Multi-child linking via admission numbers, real-time attendance alerts, fee invoice payments, direct teacher chat.

### 5. Security & Isolation Guarantee
- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC).
- Fail-closed tenant isolation (`schoolId` enforcement across all database queries).
- Constant-time secret comparison for webhooks (`crypto.timingSafeEqual`).
- Strict rate-limiting on sensitive API and authentication endpoints.

---

## Technical Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router, React 19, TypeScript)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL (Supabase) with Drizzle ORM
- **Authentication**: Supabase Auth with custom multi-identity resolution (`resolveIdentities`)
- **Real-time Sync**: Supabase Realtime (WebSockets)
- **Payments**: Korapay Payment Gateway Integration
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS & Lucide React
